description_en: Queries the details of a disaster recovery plan
name: DescribeGtmRecoveryPlan

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the disaster recovery plan. <props="china">You can obtain the ID by calling the DescribeGtmRecoveryPlans (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describegtmrecoveryplans) operation.</props>
<props="intl">You can obtain the ID by calling the DescribeGtmRecoveryPlans (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describegtmrecoveryplans?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
容灾预案ID。<props="china">可通过调用DescribeGtmRecoveryPlans  (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describegtmrecoveryplans?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_13_5.6dd83618vW4yD7)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用DescribeGtmRecoveryPlans  (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describegtmrecoveryplans?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: recovery_plan_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

FaultAddrPoolNum.description_en: The number of faulty address pools

FaultAddrPool.description_en: The list of faulty address pools

items.description_en: The list of faulty address pools

AddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the address pool

AddrPoolName.description_en: The name of the address pool

Mode.description_en:
The address mode. Valid values:

ONLINE: Always online. The address can be resolved regardless of the health check status.

OFFLINE: Always offline. The address cannot be resolved regardless of the health check status.

SMART: Smart return. The resolvability of the address is determined by the health check status
Mode.description_zh:
地址模式：

ONLINE：永远在线，不论健康检查是否异常，该地址均可解析；

OFFLINE：永远离线，不论健康检查是否异常，该地址均不可解析；

SMART：智能返回，根据健康检查的状态决定该地址是否可解析；

LastExecuteTime.description_en: The last execution time in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ
LastExecuteTime.description_zh: 最近执行时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

LastExecuteTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the last execution

LastRollbackTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last rollback

LastRollbackTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the last rollback

Name.description_en: The name of the disaster recovery plan

RecoveryPlanId.description_en: The ID of the disaster recovery plan

Status.description_en:
The status of the disaster recovery plan. Valid values:

UNEXECUTED: The disaster recovery domain name is not executed.

EXECUTED: The disaster recovery domain name is executed.

ROLLED_BACK: The disaster recovery plan is rolled back
Status.description_zh:
容灾预案状态：

UNEXECUTED：容灾域名处于未执行状态；

EXECUTED：容灾域名处于执行状态；

ROLLED_BACK：容灾预案处于回滚状态；

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ
